## Specification

### Component: Switch

A `role="switch"` button for a setting that applies immediately. Track plus thumb; the thumb slides on a spring that never overshoots and widens slightly while pressed.

#### Anatomy
```
<button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked data-state="checked|unchecked" class="ui-switch [ui-switch-sm]">
  <span class="ui-switch-thumb" aria-hidden>
</button>
<input type="hidden" name value>            only while on, when `name` is set and not disabled
```
With `label` or `description`, everything is wrapped:
```
<div class="ui-switch-field [ui-switch-field-start]" data-disabled>
  <button …/>
  <span class="ui-switch-text"><label for=id class="ui-switch-label"> <span id class="ui-switch-description">
```

#### Props
- `checked` / `defaultChecked` / `onCheckedChange(checked)` — controlled or uncontrolled. `onClick` still fires; `preventDefault()` cancels the toggle.
- `size`: `sm` track 32×18 · `md` 40×24 (default). `name`, `value` (default `"on"`), `required`.
- `label`, `description` (`aria-describedby`), `labelPosition` `end` (default) · `start` (row-reverse, space-between), `fieldClassName` (row); `className` goes to the button; `id` is used for the `<label for>` (generated otherwise).

#### Visual rules
- Track radius full; unchecked `--ui-control-track`, checked `--ui-control-on`. Thumb 20px (sm 14px), 2px inset, `--ui-control-thumb`, `--ui-shadow-sm`.
- Thumb x when on = track width − thumb − 2×2px. Pressed: thumb width + 4px (sm 3px); when on it also shifts left by that amount so the right edge stays put.
- Hover (fine pointers): track tints 12%. Disabled: opacity .5, `cursor: not-allowed`; the row dims its text.
- Coarse pointers: a `::after` grows the tap area to 44px without changing the visible size.
- Row: gap 12px; the switch aligns to the first text line; label 14px/500; description 13px muted.

#### Motion
- Thumb `transform` on `--ui-spring-smooth` (540ms, no overshoot — the state report never flickers past its end); thumb `width` 150ms `--ui-ease-out`; track colour 220ms `--ui-ease-standard`.
- Reduced motion: thumb jumps, colour changes.

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA switch: Space and Enter toggle; `aria-checked` is `true|false`. Name via the label, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.
- Focus ring on `:focus-visible`: `0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent)`.

#### Acceptance checks
- Click, tap, Space and Enter toggle; clicking the label text toggles.
- `aria-checked` flips immediately; thumb travel equals the measured track width − thumb − 4px.
- Hidden input appears only while on and named; disabled switches ignore input.
- Light, dark, every accent.

### `ui/components/switch/switch.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useId, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type MouseEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';

export type SwitchSize = 'sm' | 'md';

export interface SwitchProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'role'> {
  /** Controlled state. Pair with `onCheckedChange`. */
  checked?: boolean;
  /** Initial state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultChecked?: boolean;
  /** Called with the new state when toggled. */
  onCheckedChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
  /** Track size: `sm` 32×18, `md` 40×24. Default `md`. */
  size?: SwitchSize;
  /** Form field name. A hidden input with `value` is rendered while the switch is on. */
  name?: string;
  /** Submitted value while on. Default `"on"`. */
  value?: string;
  /** Marks the switch as required for the form. */
  required?: boolean;
  /** Visible label. Rendering one wraps the switch in a row; without it, pass `aria-label` or your own `<label htmlFor>`. */
  label?: ReactNode;
  /** Secondary text under the label. */
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Put the label before the switch and push them apart (settings rows). Default `end`. */
  labelPosition?: 'start' | 'end';
  /** Classes for the wrapper row (only rendered with `label` or `description`). */
  fieldClassName?: string;
}

/**
 * Switch — a `role="switch"` button for settings that apply immediately.
 * Space and Enter toggle it. Controlled or uncontrolled; submits through a
 * hidden input when `name` is set.
 */
export const Switch = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, SwitchProps>(function Switch(
  {
    checked,
    defaultChecked = false,
    onCheckedChange,
    size = 'md',
    name,
    value = 'on',
    required,
    label,
    description,
    labelPosition = 'end',
    fieldClassName,
    className,
    disabled,
    id,
    onClick,
    'aria-describedby': describedBy,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const [on, setOn] = useControllableState({ value: checked, defaultValue: defaultChecked, onChange: onCheckedChange });
  const generated = useId();
  const switchId = id ?? generated;
  const descId = `${switchId}-description`;
  const hasText = label != null || description != null;

  const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    onClick?.(e);
    if (!e.defaultPrevented) setOn(!on);
  };

  const control = (
    <>
      <button
        ref={ref}
        id={switchId}
        type="button"
        role="switch"
        aria-checked={on}
        aria-required={required || undefined}
        aria-describedby={cn(description != null && descId, describedBy) || undefined}
        data-state={on ? 'checked' : 'unchecked'}
        disabled={disabled}
        className={cn('ui-switch', size !== 'md' && `ui-switch-${size}`, className)}
        onClick={handleClick}
        {...props}
      >
        <span className="ui-switch-thumb" aria-hidden="true" />
      </button>
      {name && on && !disabled && <input type="hidden" name={name} value={value} />}
    </>
  );

  if (!hasText) return control;

  return (
    <div className={cn('ui-switch-field', labelPosition === 'start' && 'ui-switch-field-start', fieldClassName)} data-disabled={disabled ? '' : undefined}>
      {control}
      <span className="ui-switch-text">
        {label != null && (
          <label htmlFor={switchId} className="ui-switch-label">
            {label}
          </label>
        )}
        {description != null && (
          <span id={descId} className="ui-switch-description">
            {description}
          </span>
        )}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/switch.css`

```css
/* Switch ------------------------------------------------------------------
   <button class="ui-switch [ui-switch-sm]" role="switch" aria-checked data-state="checked|unchecked">
     <span class="ui-switch-thumb">
   Optional row: <div class="ui-switch-field [ui-switch-field-start]"> switch + .ui-switch-text (.ui-switch-label, .ui-switch-description)
   Tokens: --ui-control-on (checked track), --ui-control-track, --ui-control-thumb.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-switch {
    --sw-w: 2.5rem;
    --sw-h: 1.5rem;
    --sw-pad: 2px;
    --sw-thumb: 1.25rem;
    --sw-grow: 0.25rem;
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    width: var(--sw-w);
    height: var(--sw-h);
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-control-track);
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-switch-sm {
    --sw-w: 2rem;
    --sw-h: 1.125rem;
    --sw-thumb: 0.875rem;
    --sw-grow: 0.1875rem;
  }
  /* Phones: keep the visible size, grow the tap area to 44px */
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: calc((var(--sw-h) - 2.75rem) / 2) -0.375rem; }
  }

  .ui-switch[aria-checked="true"] { background-color: var(--ui-control-on); }

  .ui-switch-thumb {
    --sw-x: 0px;
    display: block;
    width: var(--sw-thumb);
    height: var(--sw-thumb);
    margin-inline-start: var(--sw-pad);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-control-thumb);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-sm);
    transform: translateX(var(--sw-x));
    transition:
      transform var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth),
      width var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out);
  }
  .ui-switch[aria-checked="true"] .ui-switch-thumb { --sw-x: calc(var(--sw-w) - var(--sw-thumb) - 2 * var(--sw-pad)); }

  /* The thumb widens while pressed; the checked thumb keeps its right edge */
  .ui-switch:active:not(:disabled) .ui-switch-thumb { width: calc(var(--sw-thumb) + var(--sw-grow)); }
  .ui-switch[aria-checked="true"]:active:not(:disabled) .ui-switch-thumb { --sw-x: calc(var(--sw-w) - var(--sw-thumb) - var(--sw-grow) - 2 * var(--sw-pad)); }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-switch[aria-checked="false"]:hover:not(:disabled) { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-control-track) 88%, var(--ui-foreground)); }
    .ui-switch[aria-checked="true"]:hover:not(:disabled) { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-control-on) 88%, var(--ui-background)); }
  }
  .ui-switch:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-switch:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

  /* Row with label + description */
  .ui-switch-field { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-switch-field-start { flex-direction: row-reverse; justify-content: space-between; }
  .ui-switch-field > .ui-switch { margin-top: calc((var(--text-base--line-height) - var(--sw-h)) / 2); }
  .ui-switch-text { display: grid; gap: 0.125rem; min-width: 0; }
  .ui-switch-label { font-size: var(--text-base); line-height: var(--text-base--line-height); font-weight: 500; color: var(--ui-foreground); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }
  .ui-switch-description { font-size: var(--text-sm); line-height: var(--text-sm--line-height); color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }
  .ui-switch-field[data-disabled] .ui-switch-label { cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-switch-field[data-disabled] .ui-switch-text { opacity: 0.5; }
}
```

## Usage

**Notification settings** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/switch/settings.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Switch } from '@/ui/components/switch';

export default function SwitchSettings() {
  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-4">
      <Switch
        labelPosition="start"
        label="Deploy notifications"
        description="Get an email when a deployment succeeds or fails."
        defaultChecked
      />
      <Switch labelPosition="start" label="Weekly digest" description="A summary of activity every Monday at 9 am." />
      <Switch labelPosition="start" label="Marketing emails" description="Product news and offers, at most once a month." />
    </div>
  );
}
```
